about: An answer to the prepared summary request of exercise 2, for participants who have no assistant.
constructed_note: Constructed for the build as a stand-in. No assistant produced this text from the request file. It was written to contain two mistakes an assistant commonly makes with this thread: a customer's claim reported as a fact, and a figure cited to the wrong message. A real recording is owed: send the request file, unchanged, to an assistant and replace this answer and this file.
